Bog Creeper

A flat, mud-coloured body with too many eyes, noticed only once the water moves.

HP 28
Ferocity 2 Size Normal
Movement 8 m, swimming 12 m Armor Mud hide (D4)

Bog camouflageIn water or reeds, AWARENESS to notice it is rolled with a bane.

ToughThe first hit each round inflicts only half damage.

MONSTER ATTACKS
D6 ATTACK
1–2 Tongue LashDamage D10. The target is dragged towards the water and is Prone.
3–4 BiteDamage 2D6.
5–6 Mud ThrowOne target within 10 meters is blinded until the end of the round.
GM Note Lures prey to the shore with a soft gurgling. Retreats at once from fire.
Campaign Book p. 40
